blocks.text: Compilers translator ki ek qism hain jo poore program ko chalne (execution) se pehle high-level language se machine code mein badalte hain. Compilers ka maqsad code ko behtar (optimize) kar ke efficient machine code mein badalna hai. Misalein:
GCC: C aur C++ ke liye GNU Compiler Collection. Javac: Java programs ka compiler.

blocks.prompt: Compiler program ko kab translate karta hai, aur kya banata hai?
blocks.explanation: Program chalne se pehle, poora ek saath; yeh efficient machine code banata hai jise computer seedha chala sakta hai.

items: Compilers: poora program chalne se pehle efficient machine code mein; GCC (C/C++), Javac (Java).
